study.question: Which incoming operand paths of the aligned normalized product carry the observed seed42 donor-rule effect: target fields, history fields, or their coordinated training? Observed limitation: r0014-train_objective_audit reports product-gradient relative differences0.4022149641/0.4203417826 but total category/brand embedding differences0.0010647156/0.0160164880 at two BCE training states. Other unchanged paths, role aggregation, cancellation and optimization remain unseparated. The joint donor endpoint r0013-scale_half_audit has validation AUC0.6151021885074872 versus r0013-full_audit0.6149816911798147; this selected small difference is preliminary. The preferred independent-seed question remains unavailable because this propose interface fixes seed42. This separately bounded intervention completes two missing cells of a 2x2 target/history backward-routing factorial; it does not substitute for robustness or repeat the previous audit. Memory advice is examined as evidence, not execution authority. Current runtime explicitly authorizes candidate model modules and host-submitted variants, with no manual training or reseeding.
study.hypothesis: Provisional mechanism hypothesis: the small joint donor advantage depends on coordinated changes to BOTH incoming product-operand gradients while they train shared embeddings, rather than being fully reproduced by either role alone. At the same forward/state each role receives either the existing own-event or scale-half tangent VJP. Under scratch training predict A11>A10 and A11>A01 and positive AUC interaction I=A11-A10-A01+A00. This is a falsifiable seed42 optimization hypothesis, not a claim that cancellation is already observed, that roles are disentangled, or that this effect generalizes.

falsifiers: Material source/config/initialization/sample-order/checkpoint mismatch, nonzero common-forward differences, wrong mask/floor/rank behavior, synthetic VJP error>1e-9, nonfinite logits/diagnostics, or changed parameter count invalidates isolation; an execution failure is not scientific counterevidence.

Either mixed cell matching/exceeding A11 numerically, or I_auc<=0, weakens the coordinated-both-path account at this seed. Do not claim equivalence from a small difference or interpret single-seed reversal as universal refutation.
Both mixed cells may lose to own/own or all contrasts may be tiny: retain this as null/negative implementation evidence, with adaptive seed42 selection remaining an alternative.

Persistent role-VJP differences do not establish measured shared-gradient cancellation, optimizer-update mediation, temporal/action semantics, or population generalization. No such conclusion may follow from this study alone.
alternative_explanations: Seed42 initialization, adaptive validation reuse and checkpoint/Adam paths explain the incumbent gap and any new ranking; independent authorized paired seeds remain the key unresolved test.
One operand role alone supplies the effect, or role changes add without positive interaction; incoming paths share embedding tables so relative signs/aggregation can differ.

Other static/query/history-value paths dilute product effects; cancellation, shared IDs and Adam moments are distinct unmeasured explanations. This intervention is not a full causal mediation decomposition.

Native-autograd accumulation order differs in mixed graphs, and split normalization increases training work; historical-control or implementation differences can mimic effects. Source checks reduce but do not eliminate this concern.
Stable ties/wraparound, event scale/direction coupling and coarse fields rather than behavior meaning explain effects. Existing negative action and chronology branches remain relevant.

External feature transport/query generation may help other tasks but no forward-capacity bottleneck is locally identified; importing those architectures here would confound this backward-path question.
